rationale: Late-stage batch fermentation: amino acids and short-chain fatty acids are limiting. Catabolizing remaining butyrate, acetate, and branched-chain amino acids (Phe, Tyr, Leu, Ile) plus glycine. Formate oxidation supports fermentation. Modest growth (0.20 /h) consistent with nutrient depletion. Excess nitrogen released as ammonia. Carbon conserved; fermentation products CO₂ and H₂ expected.
